resources.string: Voice cloning on your phone, or your PC
No voices yet. Add one below: record it or pick an audio file.

Read the example text aloud, record any speech (yours, or a video playing near the phone), or pick an audio file. Up to 25 s is used. Speech recognition then writes down what was said for you to check.
Read this aloud at your normal pace, then tap Stop recording:

Every morning I grab a coffee from the little place down the road, check the weather, and walk the dog around the park as usual. Yesterday the sky looked grey and heavy, so we hurried past the noisy playground and the old church, then danced across the wet grass to the quiet beach, just before the thunder and lightning arrived.
G\'day! This is my voice, cloned and spoken entirely on this phone. No internet needed.
More threads isn\'t faster: 4 is fastest on most phones.
